fields.test: Complete blood count and abdominal ultrasound

narrative: The patient's complete blood count showed a white blood cell count of 15,800 cells per microliter, indicating an acute inflammatory response. The abdominal ultrasound revealed an inflamed, non-compressible appendix measuring 9 mm in diameter, consistent with acute appendicitis. These findings support the clinical diagnosis and suggest that surgical intervention may be warranted to prevent complications such as perforation or abscess formation.
